page.notes: Marginal reference "Ierem. 4. 2." is split over two lines in the right margin; the bottom line "cio" is the last word of the text, and "4. 2." completes the note. Small stray marks in the text column near "juratu-" (about x 775) and in the right margin (about x 900) are unclear and not transcribed. The "a" and "b" reference marks are read as printed. The word "suâ-quam" is transcribed with its printed hyphen; the long s is read as s. "construction" is set with a ct ligature, written here as "structionem".
